name: @smartanalyst/tag
description: SmartAnalyst.io tracking script (StandardTag) — installé chez les clients, envoie des événements à l'ingestion temps-réel. Cible: <3KB gzipped.

scripts.size: node esbuild.config.mjs && gzip -c dist/sa.js | wc -c | awk '{printf "gzipped: %d bytes (%.1fKB)\n", $1, $1/1024}'
